description: Skelet P10-C2: pattern taxonomy inspection UI over qualified taxonomy reads (no new backend)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: new /patterns page plus patterns-ui source tests only; taxonomy REST/MCP/DB untouched; gallery/flows/boards/lens unchanged; no schema, migration, donor import, or permission change? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the UI factually correct: lists /api/v1/patterns with query filter and top-level cursor pagination; inspects /api/v1/patterns/{slug}; renders stable skelet://pattern URIs with counts plus link relation/kind/title; missing descriptions read explicitly; unknown slugs surface the server not-found?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 5 patterns-ui source tests pass; lint/typecheck clean; production build includes /patterns; graft build/check green; no mock data; capture-time recording honestly deferred to flow player and rrweb?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: unrecognized-shape fail-closed; HTTP/network failures announced; loading/empty states; cursor pagination; no hardcoded credentials; withheld patterns stay empty server-side?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-C2 taxonomy UI grain: pattern writes, rrweb capture, or unrelated refactors? Is the capture boundary honestly documented instead of claimed?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: bearer token from user input only; no title oracle in copy; no XSS (no innerHTML/eval); no secrets; actor scoping untouched server-side?
